title: Boxes Like FabFitFun: 6 FabFitFun Alternatives - Cratejoy
summary: Want a box like FabFitFun? Compare six self-care and beauty subscriptions by price, cadence, and contents, from monthly boxes to skincare only.
body_markdown:
## Questions before switching


Which alternative is closest to FabFitFun?


TheraBox, for the beauty-and-wellness mix in full sizes every month. If the accessories and the book were the draw, SinglesSwag keeps more of that spread. Neither lets you pick the items.


Can I choose what goes in any of these boxes?


Not item by item. PinkSeoul builds around the skin type and focus you give it, SinglesSwag lets you pick a size, and 180° lets you pause a month. If filling out the menu each season is the part you like most, FabFitFun’s Customization has no equal on this list.


Is there a bath-only option?


Yes.[Bath Bevy](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/bath-bevy) sends five to seven handmade, small-batch bath and body items a month for $47, with a Tubless option for people who shower. The listing is new to Cratejoy as of this summer, which is why it isn’t in the main list.


What’s the least I can spend and still get a box?


The[Self Care Pamper Pack](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/self-care-pamper-pack-wickedgoodperfume) from Wicked Good Perfume is $21.50 a month for three items: a natural color cosmetic, a skincare treatment, and a surprise, with free US shipping. Three items is a different scale from six, so treat it as a top-up rather than a replacement.


Can I send one of these as a gift?


The Cratejoy boxes can be given as a gift from the listing page. Gift orders are non-recurring, and some sellers let you pick a gift length. The seller ships on its own schedule, so check the listing’s ship window before you plan around a date. FabFitFun’s gift route is different: gift boxes are sold in sets of five or more at $79.99 each, or you can buy a gift card toward a membership.
